note: Design catalog. Runtime OpenAPI/MCP schemas generated from Go. Path fields become path params; GET page.limit/page.cursor flatten to limit/cursor, other scalar fields query params; complex filters use documented JSON query parameters. REST mutations map retryReference to Idempotency-Key; remaining arguments are JSON body except multipart upload. MCP uses declared input object directly. Every mutation returns result+receipt.
